modules.title: Galaxy ID
modules.description: Creates a local Galaxy ID and device-held key material. It is not an account, verified identity, or public profile.

modules.title: Coding Case workspace
modules.description: Lets an AI host create local Coding Case Drafts and preserve attempted approaches.

modules.title: Disclosure and consent controls
modules.description: Adds local disclosure previews, expiry-limited consent receipts, revocation, and Local Proof Drafts.

modules.title: Galaxy MCP workspace
modules.description: Makes the selected local workflow available to an MCP-capable AI host over stdio.

modules.title: AI-guided setup
modules.description: Provides a Skill that guides module selection and requires an explicit user confirmation before initialization.

notes: Initialization writes only local configuration and, when Galaxy ID is selected, local key material.
No selected module uploads Case content, publishes Proof, creates a remote account, or enables remote sync.

initializationPath.title: Personal Galaxy
initializationPath.description: Start a normal local client with a person or organization identity, ordinary work recording, own-Agent summaries and optional network access.
initializationPath.doesNotMean: A remote account, public profile, Worker, Hub membership, verified capability, or automatic sharing.

initializationPath.title: Personal Galaxy
initializationPath.description: Start a normal local client with a person or organization identity, ordinary work recording, own-Agent summaries and optional network access.
initializationPath.doesNotMean: A remote account, public profile, Worker, Hub membership, verified capability, or automatic sharing.

notes: This is a read-only architecture preview. No runtime, local configuration, or Galaxy ID will be created.
Galaxy Worker is planned and cannot be initialized in Founding Beta.

initializationPath.title: Galaxy Worker
initializationPath.description: Run a specialized Agent continuously under a Worker policy, with versioned configuration and human-authorized context.
initializationPath.doesNotMean: Automatic task acceptance, access to raw Case context, automatic settlement, or proof of capability.

notes: This is a read-only architecture preview. No runtime, local configuration, or Galaxy ID will be created.
Galaxy Hub is planned and cannot be initialized in Founding Beta.

initializationPath.title: Galaxy Hub
initializationPath.description: Operate a community or organization Galaxy with its own local policy, evidence network, data boundary, and optional Workers.
initializationPath.doesNotMean: Ownership of member Galaxy IDs, permission to rewrite facts, or authority to fabricate external Evidence.
